hero.statement: Software built for how your business actually works.
hero.support: I build tailored digital products and experiences to solve real needs, simplify processes, and grow new ideas.

approach.title: How I work.
paragraphs: Every project starts by understanding the problem before choosing how to solve it. Beyond the product being requested, I look at how the business works, where friction exists, and what change would create meaningful impact.
From there, I design around the people who will use the solution. Their context, priorities, and expectations guide product decisions far more than any specific technology.

I work with deliberate scope: fewer features, better resolved. That creates room to refine the entire experience, from core flows to the small details that make a product feel clear, reliable, and thoughtfully built.

capabilities.title: What I can build with you.

groups.name: Internal tools and operations
groups.description: Systems that organize, automate, and simplify everyday work: management, operations, data, permissions, reporting, and internal workflows.

groups.name: AI and automation

capabilities.note: My core expertise is in web products and platforms, though many projects naturally extend into adjacent areas. If yours does, we can evaluate it with clarity and transparency from the start.

studio.title: For work that needs a team.
studio.body: Alongside my own projects I build with Atomic Software Studio, which takes on intelligent and automated systems for businesses. When a project needs more hands than mine, it goes there.

contact.title: Let's talk about what you're building.
contact.body: If your business needs something off-the-shelf solutions cannot quite solve, or you have an idea worth turning into a well-built product, tell me about it.
